sn35.56:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– kathannu kho bhante, jānato kathaṃ passato āsavā pahīyantīti. cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu, aniccato jānato passato āsavā pahīyanti. rūpe …pe…
sn35.56:1.2: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ …pe… cakkhusamphassaṃ …pe… yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato āsavā pahīyanti. evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato āsavā pahīyantīti.
